title: Frozen Key Lime Pie
description: A cheat's frozen key lime pie with a dark chocolate digestive base, zingy lime cream cheese filling and a biscuit crumb topping.
steps: Line a 20cm round cake tin with baking paper.
Microwave 14 digestives for 30 seconds, blitz to crumbs. Add 1 heaped teaspoon of cream cheese to help bind. Press into the tin and refrigerate.
Whip the remaining cream cheese until fluffy. Grate the zest of both limes, squeeze the juice, add half the zest and all the juice to the cream cheese. Mix.
Spread over the biscuit base. Crush the remaining digestive, mix with leftover zest and sprinkle on top.
Freeze for 3–4 hours until the top is like ice cream.
Take out 20 minutes before serving. Slice with a warmed knife.
notes: Serves 8–10. Keeps in the freezer for at least a month.
